_doc: Fleet naming and addressing rule (ticket #1100). Private address {container}.app, public address {container}.diegonmarcos.com, every public URL bearer/session protected except unprotected_hosts, no api.* host. Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs. transitional lists known violations while the #1100 phases migrate them; an entry that stops violating must be removed, and every list must be empty at phase P4. Ticket #1104 (routing reorganisation) supersedes the public-host part of #1100: tiers below.

unprotected_hosts.auth.diegonmarcos.com: HTML+API: Authelia login portal and OIDC endpoints, must be reachable before any session exists
unprotected_hosts.c3-pub-api.diegonmarcos.com: API pub: analytics beacons, JMAP discovery, health
unprotected_hosts.vpn.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: WireGuard ws-tunnel and mesh bootstrap; peers hold no bearer before the tunnel exists
unprotected_hosts.analytics.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: public-site analytics beacons (matomo, umami, openobserve); to fold into c3-pub-api
unprotected_hosts.matrix.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: Matrix federation and client .well-known; matrix is federated
unprotected_hosts.jmap.diegonmarcos.com: protocol: JMAP session discovery (.well-known/jmap); Stalwart enforces Basic auth itself
unprotected_hosts.c3-pub.diegonmarcos.com: API pub: Cloudflare-proxied explicit allowlist (tiers.pub.allowlist), everything else 404

tiers._doc: Routing tiers (ticket #1104). pub: Cloudflare proxied (orange), unauthenticated, explicit allowlist only. pvt: DNS-only (grey), path per container, Authelia session cookie (web) OR fleet bearer (API/MCP clients) through the shared edge_auth gate. mesh: {container}.app, WireGuard is the trust boundary. Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs reads infra-sec_caddy/dist/configs/Caddyfile.

pub._portals_doc: The Authelia portal keeps its own host (cookie domain, OIDC issuer); /auth and /account on c3-pub redirect to it until the IdP can run under a sub-path.

public._doc: Owner ruling 2026-10-22: the apex, www and linktree.diegonmarcos.com (explicitly declared, serves /gh, /qrcode and static assets) are the ONLY unauthenticated public HTML hosts. There is no public wildcard route; the *.diegonmarcos.com catch-all site only redirects to the apex and reaches no upstream. The guard rejects any wildcard site that proxies, serves files or responds with content.
